# Nelsy

> Nelsy is a booking app built for independent nail technicians. It lets nail techs accept online bookings, collect deposits, take payments, manage their schedule, and turn Instagram followers into paying clients.

## Product

- **Name**: Nelsy
- **Website**: https://getnelsy.com
- **Pricing**: $29.99/month after a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
- **Commission**: 0% booking commission. Nelsy charges a flat monthly fee only. Standard payment processing fees apply.
- **Trial**: 14 days free. No commitment.
- **Audience**: Independent nail technicians, solo nail artists, home-based nail techs

## Key Features

- Online booking page — clients book services directly from a link
- Deposit collection — require deposits before confirming appointments
- Integrated payments — Stripe-powered card payments
- Schedule management — calendar and availability control
- Instagram workflow — booking links for bio and DMs

## Content

Nelsy publishes practical guides and resources for nail techs at https://getnelsy.com/blog

Topics include:
- Getting clients and growing a nail business
- Instagram content strategy for nail techs
- Nail tech pricing and profitability
- Booking software comparisons
- Cancellation policies and deposits
- Nail education and technique
